title: Spectral-Convolutional Factorized Transformer for Joint Multipath Parameter Estimation: Applications to mmWave Positioning and Radio SLAM
abstract: arXiv:2611.01491v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Future 6G wireless networks are expected to evolve toward AI-native systems that support intelligent, environment-aware services, including positioning and mapping. Current research has already integrated AI into several aspects of communication, particularly wireless channel estimation. However, most learning-based channel estimators focus on communication-oriented objectives rather than explicitly estimating multipath parameters such as delay, angle of arrival (AoA), and angle of departure (AoD). translated_title: 用于联合多径参数估计的谱-卷积分解Transformer：在毫米波定位与无线电SLAM中的应用
translated_abstract: 未来的6G无线网络有望向AI原生系统演进，以支持智能化、环境感知的服务，包括定位与建图。当前的研究已将人工智能整合到通信的多个方面，尤其是无线信道估计。然而，大多数基于学习的信道估计器关注面向通信的目标，而非显式估计诸如时延、到达角（AoA）和离开角（AoD）等多径参数。这些参数为定位和无线电同步定位与建图（SLAM）等下游任务提供了关键的几何信息。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种谱-卷积分解Transformer（SCFT），用于从含噪的复数信道估计和物理波束对描述子中联合估计多径分量（MPC）。SCFT结合了局部谱卷积、置换等变的波束集注意力（此处摘要被截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种谱-卷积分解Transformer（SCFT），能够从含噪信道估计中联合估计时延、到达角和离开角等多径参数，为毫米波定位和无线电SLAM等下游任务提供关键几何信息。
en_tdlr: A Spectral-Convolutional Factorized Transformer (SCFT) is proposed to jointly estimate multipath parameters (delay, AoA, AoD) from noisy channel estimates, enabling downstream mmWave positioning and radio SLAM applications.
